body:
## ❄️   SnowClear   ❄️ 

«Powerful, lightweight plugin to keep your server smooth and lag-free.»

---

🚀 Features

- ⚡ Automatic item clearing system
- 🧠 Smart TPS-based lag detection
- 🔔 Custom warning alerts before cleanup
- 🛡️ Permission-based command control
- ⚙️ Fully configurable system
- 📊 Optimized for performance

---

📦 Commands

/snowclear

«Manually clear all dropped items from the server»

Permission:
"snowclear.use"

---

⚙️ How It Works

- Plugin automatically monitors server performance
- If TPS drops below threshold, cleanup is triggered
- Items are cleared at regular intervals
- Players receive warnings before cleanup

---

🔧 Configuration

You can fully customize behavior in "config.yml":

clear-interval: 300
tps-threshold: 15.0
warning-times:
  - 60
  - 30
  - 10

---

📊 Performance

- Lightweight and efficient
- Designed for survival, lifesteal & SMP servers
- Minimal impact on server resources

---

🧩 Compatibility

- Works with Paper / Spigot servers
- Supports Minecraft 1.20+

---

⚠️ Important

- Avoid using "/reload"
- Always restart server after installing plugin
- Ensure proper permissions are set

---

❤️ Support

If you like this plugin, consider:

- ⭐ Starring the project
- 📢 Sharing with others
